description: The Magpie has locked Netville's sorting room with six trick locks, and your six Defender stamps are the keys. Route the golden letter, turn the cipher wheel, spot the real Pim from footprint clues, judge the trick inbox, run the five moves in order, and match each threat to the layer that stops it. No timer and no failing: wrong tries wobble the lock, three hint feathers help, and the finishing shield honestly shows how many hints you used.
notes: Cyber Defenders finale (step 6.4, both bands), built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.2 (pinned kit tag plus the art-props, art-animals, art-school and style-bold packs, as Packet Post). One shell, six lock rooms wrapping platform mechanics (routing board, cipher wheel, message cards, response choices, ordering, matching); Pim is the kit owl in Packet Post's own look (owl, backpack, cocoa/spark) — characters come from their own games, never redrawn; the Magpie has no kit sprite, so it appears as its locks and feathers, not a substitute drawing. Fair-test rules by construction: the engine has no failed state (a wrong try wobbles and Pim nudges), no clock is read anywhere, three hint feathers serve the whole room (one per lock at most) and hints used are shown honestly on the completion shield, locks open in stamp order, and per-lock progress saves in BRB.storage (escape-the-post-office-v1) so leaving and returning resumes. Lock 4 is a compact self-contained round in the Trick Inbox idiom (Deliver it / Bin it / Show Pim / Report and block, with the missed-clue debrief on a wrong call; Explorer 6 items, Pro 8 including a faked sender); its data shape is the interface for swapping in the standalone Trick Inbox engine later. The first classic script is window.EscapePostOffice (the pure engine: LOCKS with the lock-to-unit/stamp/skill/standards mapping, DATA per band, Run per lock with advice() solvers, and the Escape room aggregate). Completion is win-gated: BRB.score.submit and BRB.gameOver({won:true}) fire exactly once, when the sixth lock opens and the shield shows; BRB.progress reports each opened lock. Test hooks: __brbTest.start({band, seed, fresh}), state(), act(action), hint(), solveLock(), solve(), cover(), skipAnimations(). English-first; translations follow the course's language-pack route.
title: Escape the Post Office
